basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Technical Deployment Lead · Forward Deployed Engineering · AI/LLM Delivery, Adoption & ROI · MBA
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who owns AI delivery end to end: I embed with a customer's team, translate business outcomes into a technical plan, and drive 0-to-1 prototypes through MVP to production. Through my practice, Anand Creations, delivery is the job: map the workflow, sequence the work, ship on time, then codify reusable patterns and evals so the next deployment is faster. I run to the metric, not the milestone: at LumApps my agent deployments 2x conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue against baselines and KPIs, reported to C-level; at Beekeeper an LLM pipeline cut $337K in cost. MBA-trained translator between engineers and executives, with sector depth in financial services and comfort embedding onsite with customers.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI delivery end to end: translates business goals into a technical plan, ships to production, drives adoption, and reports outcomes to C-level.
highlights: Owned delivery end to end, from discovery to production: translated business goals into a roadmap with milestones and acceptance criteria, and reported ROI to C-level (2x conversions, forecast $1M in quarterly revenue) against baselines and KPIs.
Drove 0-to-1 agent prototypes through MVP to production (Python, LangGraph, MCP), codifying reusable solution patterns and eval pipelines and feeding field insights back into product strategy.
Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph retrieval layer integrating 5+ systems, and led adoption so the agents became part of the daily workflow.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who owned delivery and ROI for AI products used by millions, turning one-off wins into reusable patterns and coaching the team around them.
highlights: Delivered an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks with evaluation gates, eliminating $337K in annual vendor cost. Value case, baseline, and measured outcome, not just a ship.
Turned deployments into operating leverage: a distributed templating engine and reusable module framework now power 15% of all assets created on the platform (10M+ users).

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales, each instrumented with baselines and KPIs so we knew within a week if it moved the metric. Employee Referral became the top revenue channel ($1.5M+, $500K ARR).
Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort and held delivery reliability high (99.99% SLA designs, milestones hit).

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups, advising executives and investors on architecture and AI readiness.
highlights: Advised executives and investors: ran technical discovery across 20+ companies, pattern-matching architecture and AI readiness into go/no-go investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems; advised portfolio companies on AI strategy in financial services.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Took the platform from zero to a partner-ready product under real-world constraints.
highlights: 0-to-1 delivery: shipped the platform, real-time APIs, and cloud stack from scratch. 500+ deliveries, 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Delivered enterprise-grade reliability that landed partnerships with Unilever and a showcase at CES Las Vegas.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI/ML research at the frontier of robotics, built and scaled on AWS.
highlights: Built Robogen, an open-source ML platform, and migrated the pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Taught 20+ master's students hands-on: translating a complex system into something others could build with.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Technical Deployment Lead, Forward Deployed Engineering
_jobApplication.jobDescription: OpenAI, Model Deployment for Business, Zurich (hybrid, travel up to 50%). The Forward Deployed Engineering team turns research into production systems for customers. As a Technical Deployment Lead (TDL), you own AI delivery end to end (not a management role): translate business outcomes into a technical plan; run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers; embed with customer teams to map workflows and success criteria; ensure components ship on time; lead readiness, adoption, and change management; track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing and scope trade-offs to protect the critical path; drive 0-to-1 prototypes through MVP to scale; share field insights with Product and Research; codify solution patterns and evals; own value cases and ROI (hypotheses, baselines, KPIs, pre/post measurement, exec reporting). Success is measured first by impact (deployments that deliver measurable value, drive adoption, become critical to workflows), plus delivery reliability, operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps). You'll thrive with 7+ years of customer-facing technical delivery leadership; a track record leading large, complex, high-stakes AI engagements; excellence in high-ambiguity environments; fluid movement between system-level understanding and execution detail; strategic pattern-matching; strong technical fluency and sequencing instincts; shipped AI/LLM systems (solution patterns, integration, production pitfalls); executive presence as a translator between technical trade-offs and business leaders; comfort onsite with customers (25-50%); and expertise in at least one major sector (e.g., financial services).
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit: FDE practice (Anand Creations), end-to-end AI delivery with ROI/KPIs and C-level reporting (LumApps), reusable patterns + operating leverage (Beekeeper templating engine, evals), 0-to-1 delivery (Dronistics), executive/investor advisory + pattern-matching (Tenity), MBA translator, and financial-services sector depth (SwissNRI, PulseView, Opt Alpha, Obermatt). Comfortable with 25-50% onsite travel; Zurich-based.
